description: This file contains utility functions and data structures for JSON parsing, color handling, error processing, and session key normalization used within the ai.openclaw.app.node package.

classes.name: Quad
classes.description: A generic data class representing a tuple of four elements.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts a string to a JSON-compatible escaped string.

methods.name: asObjectOrNull
methods.description: Safely casts a JsonElement to a JsonObject if possible.

methods.name: parseJsonParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, returning null if invalid or null.

methods.name: readJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonPrimitive value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonString
methods.description: Extracts a string value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonBooleanFlag
methods.description: Parses a boolean flag from a JsonObject key, recognizing 'true'/'false'.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Returns the string content of a JsonElement if it is a JsonPrimitive, or null otherwise.

methods.name: parseHexColorArgb
methods.description: Parses a hex color string (with optional #) into a Long ARGB color value.

methods.name: invokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a code-message pair using external parsing logic.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a main key string, returning null if empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a key is exactly 'main'.
